proposed_body_additions.proposed_chinese:
覆盖率还可能在选择阶段无法返回可用答案时损失。SELF-POT 把这一问题单列测量：其五模型面板对每个模型测试 100 道编程题，并对计划生成三个候选、再由同一模型选择的协议做事后回放。分母是 500 个计划执行单元，实际保留 498 个候选池，两条缺失记录仍计失败。增加“保留首个非空候选”的回退后，正确提交从 376 增至 437，且保留所有已发生的 judge 费用；覆盖空答案的回退规则是在发现一次被选答案为空后补充的。改用公开样例测试选择，则达到 453/500，并通过省去 judge 阶段，使各模型的逻辑 API 成本降低 12%–49%。[SELF-POT，v1，§2–3、附录 J.2](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.01110v1)

这些是固定候选上的受控回放，不是同等实测支出下重新运行的端到端实验。API 成本按设定价格记账，不是账单或硬件测量；本地公开测试的执行开销另报。它使已有的“覆盖—选择”区分更具体：把平台期归因于推理边界之前，还应分开记录没有成功提交与选错答案。这里确认的是所测协议中可修复的损失，不能推广为追加推理必然改善部署效果。
proposed_body_additions.proposed_english:
Coverage can also be lost when a selection stage fails to return a usable answer. SELF-POT makes this a separate measurement target. In post-hoc replays of a protocol scheduling three programming candidates and a same-model judge, its five-model panel covers 100 tasks per model: 500 scheduled cells, with 498 retained pools and two missing records counted as failures. Adding a first-nonempty-candidate fallback raises correct submissions from 376 to 437 while retaining all judge costs. The output-aware fallback rule was amended after inspecting an empty selected answer. Public-example selection instead reaches 453/500 and removes the judge stage, reducing logical API costs by 12–49% across models. [SELF-POT, v1, §§2–3 and Appendix J.2](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.01110v1)

These are controlled replays of saved candidates, not fresh end-to-end trials at matched expenditure. API costs use configured prices rather than invoices or hardware measurements; local public-test execution is reported separately. The result sharpens the existing coverage–selection distinction: record submission failures as well as wrong choices before attributing a plateau to reasoning limits. It establishes a repair in the tested protocols, not a general deployment gain from additional inference.

source_record.title: How Much Can Language Models Gain from Test-Time Computation?
source_record.problem: 正确候选存在不保证可用提交；选择器失败、接口故障和遗漏的判分成本可能伪装成推理扩展的边界
source_record.insight: 固定候选池，分开回放选择规则与提交回退，并将所有模型阶段纳入API成本账目
source_record.limitation: 五模型面板与有限任务；每个执行单元一次采样；回放为事后分析和账目反事实，不是等实测成本的新部署实验；两条编程记录缺失仍计错；逻辑API费依赖设定价格，非硬件成本；公开测试本地执行另报；部分协议按上下文或接口限制未运行
source_record.sections_read: 原站元数据与版本史；v1摘要、§1–2全部方法/预算/成本、§3.1–3.3模型与核心结果、§4讨论、Appendix J.2同池选择/回退/成本/不确定性相关段落；未完整审计其余附录、代码或图像
source_record.evidence_status: 首发2026-10-01 05:49:29 UTC，主站仅列v1；已核三候选+同模型judge、500计划单元=五模型×100题、498保留池、事后空提交规则及成本边界；未独立复现。
source_record.method: At each model, retained programming pools from three candidate generations plus same-model selection are replayed with fallback and public-example selectors; hidden grades only score choices.
source_record.result: In 500 scheduled model-task cells (498 retained pools), first-nonempty fallback changes correct submissions from 376 to 437 at unchanged logical judge spending; public-example selection yields 453 and omits judge-stage API cost.

evidence_conditions: Full benchmark contains 350 tasks: 60 mathematics, 100 coding, 160 AppWorld and 30 terminal; the proposed paragraph uses only the five-model × 100 coding scheduled cells.
Coding Parallel@4 schedules three candidate generations and one same-model joint-selection stage. The suffix is an output-budget multiplier, not the sample count.
The 498 retained coding pools comprise 496 with three recorded attempt slots and two partial GPT-OSS pools; two missing records remain wrong in the 500 denominator.
Judge plus first-nonempty fallback reaches 437; the index-only earlier rule reached 436. The additional empty-selected-answer trigger was specified after inspection and is post-hoc.

Public-only three-candidate selection reaches 453; its logical API accounting omits judge calls but keeps original generation/tool interactions. The local test replay took 838 seconds with four workers (3,299 summed worker-seconds), reported separately rather than monetized as free compute.
Each cell sampled once; same-pool replay intervals keep all five models together by task. This is not 500 independent questions or a universal model-population estimate.
limitations: Replay is a counterfactual analysis of saved outputs, not a new matched-expenditure end-to-end trial or a refund of historical spending.
Reported API cost uses configured rates, not invoices or measured hardware energy/FLOPs; absolute price-sensitive frontiers were not promoted into the paragraph.
Some original protocols were not run for context or interface reasons; the comparison is not a complete common matrix for every model.
The evidence isolates a tested selector and failure policy, not the best possible verifier; agent plans that were never executed do not furnish oracle coverage.

source_record.title: IronMind: Scaling Humanoid Dexterous Manipulation via Camera-Space Ego-Centric Pretraining
source_record.problem: 第一人称人类视频缺少躯干运动学且动作标注含噪；数据量与开环代理指标未必对应真实机器人成功率
source_record.insight: 用相机坐标动作和跨具身语义维度对齐减少显式身体重定向，单独比较数据扩展、动作坐标和辅助世界先验
source_record.limitation: 一种架构/数据混合、一个机器人平台、六项OOD任务每项10次；约40,000段目标机器人演示用于后训练，非无机器人数据迁移；预训练小时包含人类及非目标机器人数据；部分开环prior结果按同一次运行多checkpoint平均；无全成本/跨种子或独立复现保证
source_record.sections_read: 原站元数据和版本史；v1摘要、§3.1–3.3数据/表示/模型/训练、§4.1–4.5设置/多层评估/数据扩展/消融和§5局限；未视觉审计图7/10或代码、无运行复现
source_record.evidence_status: 首发2026-09-30 09:45:59 UTC，主站仅列v1；重点核验总预训练小时口径、目标机器人后训练、表4/5开环与闭环差异；保留为已定向阅读候选。
source_record.method: Camera-space action alignment across human and non-target robot sources; fixed architecture/optimization/robot-data mixture while adding human video; subsequent IRON-R01 adaptation and separate open-/closed-loop tests.
source_record.result: At 10,000 total pretraining hours, six-task real-robot success averages 55.0% without world priors, 26.7% in torso-frame control and 31.7% with world priors; ten trials per task. Auxiliary priors improve some reported open-loop metrics.

evidence_conditions: Total pretraining budgets 250–10,000 hours combine human egocentric and non-target robot data; fixed robot mixture, additional scale from human portion. These are data hours, not GPU hours.
Architecture, optimization recipe and robot-data mixture held fixed across scaling; AdamW/global batch 1024. IRON-R01 data enters only in approximately 40,000 post-training episodes.

Reported validation-loss relation is log-linear in data hours, not a verified general power law for final success. Intermediate open-loop metrics and low-budget closed-loop results are not all monotone.

Real robot comparison uses one held-out IRON-R01 unit, six OOD tasks, ten trials per task, 10Hz control. The camera-space/torso-frame comparison uses the same 10,000-hour data and post-training data/compute budget.

Table 4 world-prior open-loop ablation averages multiple checkpoints from each run; Table 5 closed-loop success is 55.0% without priors and 31.7% with priors. The paper proposes objective mismatch as an explanation, not an isolated established mechanism.
